I don’t know my when i entered my age on latent (15 year old) it deleted my acc saying its for 13 and above. I had a 3 week long streak as well. Please help me, i don’t want to lose everything please

replyDrafts.body:
Hey Tridha, I'm so sorry this happened, that's a really rough way to lose a 3 week streak 😭 The age check removed accounts when the birthday came out under 13, so the wheel probably landed on the wrong year, and we've since changed it so that can't wipe an account anymore. [CHECK: restore decision] You're welcome to sign up again with your real birthday, and I'm here if anything else goes wrong!

Eddie
